title: Per-tenant / per-deployment embedding endpoint (embedding_base_url) → local OpenAI-compatible server
priority_note: Today a tenant can BYO an embedding key + model, but NOT the endpoint — base_url is a server-wide runtime default. So embeddings can't be pointed at a local model. This adds the missing knob so a self-hosted instance (or a tenant) routes embeddings to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint, including a local Ollama/TEI.

background.reference: lib/loopctl/knowledge/embedding_client.ex:41 @default_base_url "https://api.openai.com/v1"; the moduledoc says base_url comes from runtime config. lib/loopctl/llm/tenant_llm_settings.ex has embedding_api_key + embedding_model (per-tenant) but NO embedding_base_url. So the endpoint is not tenant-overridable.
background.includes: Add embedding_base_url to TenantLlmSettings (validated URL) AND a deployment default (env). Resolution order: tenant embedding_base_url -> deployment default (EMBEDDING_BASE_URL) -> @default_base_url. Reuse the existing SettingsCache (US-32.3) + Vault patterns. Local endpoints (Ollama http://localhost:11434/v1, TEI, LM Studio) speak the OpenAI embeddings API, so no client rewrite — only the base_url plumbing.

story.i_want_to: configure the embedding endpoint (base_url) at the tenant or deployment level, not just the key and model
story.so_that: my document text is embedded by a local OpenAI-compatible model and never sent to OpenAI (or any third party)

rationale: The embedding client is already OpenAI-compatible; the only thing pinning it to OpenAI is a non-overridable base_url. Exposing embedding_base_url (tenant + deployment default) with the existing key/model BYO machinery makes local embeddings a config change, composing with US-39.1's dimension flexibility to complete the local-embedding path.

acceptance_criteria.description: TenantLlmSettings gains embedding_base_url (validated http(s) URL, nullable). The embedding client resolves base_url as: tenant.embedding_base_url || deployment EMBEDDING_BASE_URL || the OpenAI default. Unset everywhere → today's behavior (OpenAI). A test asserts each resolution level.

Set via the existing config surface: the set_llm_config MCP tool / PATCH endpoint accepts embedding_base_url; it's cached (SettingsCache) and busts on update like the other settings. Agent-discoverable (the tool schema + remediation message document it). No new UI (agent-native).

Validation + safety: only http(s) URLs; the value is stored/handled consistently with existing settings (redaction as appropriate). A misconfigured/unreachable endpoint surfaces as the existing embedding error path (circuit breaker / fallback) — it does NOT crash the request. Test: a local stub endpoint returns embeddings and they're stored.

Composes with US-39.1: when embedding_base_url points at a local model whose dimension matches the configured :embedding_dimensions, an end-to-end harvest→embed→recall works with zero call to OpenAI (asserted by a mock that fails if openai.com is contacted). Default instance unchanged.

test_cases.name: base_url resolution order
expected_results: tenant > deployment > OpenAI default; unset → OpenAI

test_cases.name: local endpoint used, no OpenAI egress
expected_results: local stub called; openai.com never contacted (mock asserts zero)

technical_notes: Files: lib/loopctl/llm/tenant_llm_settings.ex (+ migration add column), lib/loopctl/knowledge/embedding_client.ex (base_url resolution), lib/loopctl/llm.ex / settings resolution + SettingsCache (US-32.3), the set_llm_config controller/OpenAPI + MCP tool (mcp-server), config/runtime.exs (EMBEDDING_BASE_URL deployment default).
No client rewrite: Ollama/TEI/LM Studio expose the OpenAI /embeddings shape. Just thread the resolved base_url into the Req.post.
MCP-server change requires a mcp-server/package.json version bump for npm auto-publish (the #331 gotcha).
Agent-native: expose via set_llm_config + document in the tool docstring/remediation; no UI.
Config-based DI; SettingsCache bust on update; no Application.put_env in tests.
